prompt:
Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 150 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Sugar Land, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported shoulder injury. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1127; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Witnesses, photos and the other driver all confirm the accident happened as described.
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The police and witnesses confirm the claimant was in the vehicle.
- A dated inspection photo shows the same dent before this crash.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: On the afternoon in question, I was dispatched to a rear-end collision on a city street in Sugar Land, Texas. Driver 1 was stopped at a traffic signal when the vehicle behind, operated by Driver 2, struck the rear bumper at a speed consistent with the damage visible on both vehicles. Driver 2 confirmed that the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it, and two independent witnesses gave statements that matched this account. Scene photographs show crush damage to the rear of Driver 1's vehicle and a corresponding impact pattern on the front of Driver 2's vehicle. Officers confirmed that a Passenger was seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of impact, and the witnesses also placed that person there. Driver 1 reported pain in the right shoulder and was transported for evaluation. Driver 1 is listed as an insured party on the policy covering the vehicle. A prior inspection photograph of the rear panel shows a dent in the same location, which was noted for comparison during this investigation.
